# RuntimeStats

<div align="center">

[Command Index](Command-Index) · [Language Features](Language-Features) · [Other](Language-Features-Other)

</div>


```blitzbasic
RuntimeStats:Void
```

## Description

Writes how many objects exist to the debug log, which helps to find objects that are never freed. It prints `Active objects` and `Unreleased objs` (deleted objects that are waiting to be reused).

## Examples

```blitzbasic
RuntimeStats
```
